purpose: Equal-budget per-subset development retune of component CTC evidence (I,R,T,IR,IRT) at beam 8; decode only, no training
headline_policy: Main-paper Full8 rows stay the original frozen controls; retuned IRT appears only in the equal-budget control table
test_policy: All 15 selections frozen (ALL_FROZEN.json) before any test decode; each test runs once; no grid extension after test
selection_rule: minimum development WER, then CER, |beta|, alpha, beta (decoder rule)
known_limits: test sets were inspected in earlier research; exploratory, not confirmatory
local bracketing does not establish a global optimum
IRT historical setting was chosen with more exploratory development; this run gives all five subsets the same budget
resources_note: H100 shared lease 32 GiB VRAM, 12 CPUs; concurrency 6 decoder processes
